selection_rules.selection: Git tracked working files and untracked files not ignored by Git; current working contents, rather than only HEAD contents.
selection_rules.preserved: Original code, static assets, documents, licences and notices remain unchanged inside each package.
selection_rules.excluded: Git history, dependency folders, caches, temporary build output, credential/environment/key files, detected concrete secret formats, symlinks and unavailable working files.
selection_rules.working_changes: Source repositories are read only. Each package records its own capture time, HEAD, branch, start/end working status and file fingerprints.
selection_rules.scope: A repository snapshot preserves source artefacts. Live hosting configuration, external databases, unpublished records, ignored dependencies and an external WordPress installation require their own authorised handover.
selection_rules.licences: Each source retains its own licence and notices. Inclusion here does not replace those terms or grant additional rights.
selection_rules.parts: ZIP files over 90 MiB are divided into 32 MiB parts, with a fingerprint for every part and for the complete ZIP.
